mapper.select: select activity_id, goods_id, seckill_stock, seckill_remain_stock, seckill_price, seckill_start_time, seckill_end_time, status, tag_id from seckill_activity where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1

select activity_id, goods_id, seckill_stock, seckill_remain_stock, seckill_price, seckill_start_time, seckill_end_time, status, tag_id from seckill_activity where status = 1 and seckill_start_time <= now() and seckill_end_time >= now() order by seckill_start_time asc
mapper.update: update seckill_activity set seckill_remain_stock = seckill_remain_stock - 1, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId} and seckill_remain_stock > 0
update seckill_activity set seckill_remain_stock = seckill_remain_stock + 1, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId} and seckill_remain_stock < seckill_stock
